summary: Wondering if necessity is root of all philosophy. You can't go deep until you have enough to care. Food beats philosophy. Yet how you go about getting it informs everything about your worldview.

Wondering if necessity is root of all philosophy.
You can't go deep until you have enough to care. Food beats philosophy.

Yet how you go about getting it informs everything about your worldview.
